Election Year 225

Some time after {{NPCSprite|Barry}} was removed as a [[Mayor Election#Candidates|Regular Candidate]] on the Main Server, the same was done on the Alpha Network. Since the Alpha Network was running 176 days faster than the Main Server at that time and the election has already started, the candidates were reshuffled. Admins might have interfered with the mayor perks, since some candidates have gained or changed perks that is impossible with the [[Mayor Election#Perks Distribution|Perks Distribution]] system. Although {{NPCSprite|Barry}} was removed from the election, it might have counted people voted Barry before he was removed and did not change vote, which is the highest. The ballot box in the mayor interface does not show Barry's vote count.
